description: Na₂PSe₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmce space group. There are two inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six Se²⁻ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 26°. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.03-3.18 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Se²⁻ atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 3.10-3.19 Å. P⁴⁺ is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Se²⁻ atoms. There are two shorter (2.18 Å) and one longer (2.19 Å) P-Se bond length. There are two inequivalent Se²⁻ sites. In the first Se²⁻ site, Se²⁻ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na¹⁺ and one P⁴⁺ atom. In the second Se²⁻ site, Se²⁻ is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na¹⁺ and one P⁴⁺ atom.
